page: Microsoft Azure NC24ads_A100_v4 is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine designed for compute-intensive machine learning and parallel data processing tasks. The instance provides 24 dedicated physical cores on an AMD EPYC 7V13 processor operating at up to 3.7 GHz, using the x86_64 architecture with one thread per core. Memory capacity is configured at 220.0 GB of system RAM, yielding 9.17 GB per core. For accelerated computing, the instance is equipped with a single NVIDIA A100 GPU based on the Ampere architecture with 80 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM. Local scratch storage is provided via an integrated 1029 GB NVMe SSD.

Benchmark results highlight strong capabilities in specialized execution paths. Large language model inference across 135M, 7B, and 70B parameter models consistently scores in the top tier (top 10%), processing up to 3530.25 prompt tokens per second and generating 161.12 tokens per second on 7B models. Memory performance is similarly elevated, with PassMark memory tests ranking in the top 10%. In CPU-bound synthetic testing, stress-ng single-core performance and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rank in the top 25%, while standard multi-core Geekbench and PassMark CPU benchmarks register in the middle 50%. The CPU instruction set includes AVX, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI extensions, though AVX-512 and AMX instructions are absent.

Resource allocation presents a balance between high-end accelerator throughput and standard general-purpose compute. While the single 80 GB A100 GPU handles large model layers and complex matrix calculations, general database operations, Redis throughput, and web serving benchmarks remain average. The bundled 1029 GB NVMe SSD offers high-speed intermediate caching for model weights and datasets without relying entirely on remote storage volumes.

The NC24ads_A100_v4 is best suited for deep learning training and inference pipelines, particularly transformer-based language models, computer vision image processing, high-performance computing simulations, and data preprocessing tasks requiring substantial GPU memory alongside fast local NVMe storage.
description: Microsoft Azure NC24ads_A100_v4 is a GPU-accelerated instance configured with 24 dedicated AMD EPYC 7V13 physical cores running at 3.7 GHz, 220.0 GB of system RAM, and a bundled 1029 GB NVMe SSD. Its primary processing engine is a single NVIDIA A100 GPU featuring 80 GB of VRAM. In performance evaluations, the instance achieves top-tier results in LLM inference across model sizes up to 70B parameters, paired with top-decile PassMark memory bandwidth. Standard CPU multi-core operations and web serving throughput align within median industry distributions. The omission of AVX-512 instructions reflects the underlying AMD processor profile, while strong cryptographic and vector extensions support accelerated data transformation. With high system memory density and integrated NVMe storage, this instance is suited for deep learning training, LLM inference, computer vision, and GPU-accelerated scientific computing.
